title: LESS LIVE LOAD NEXT DOOR, MORE SAG HERE
claim: In the registered rigid, level, equal-span linear-elastic continuous-girder models, the governing live-load pattern loaded the target end bay and every second bay from it. The largest end-bay sag was 1.39 to 1.76 times the all-bays-loaded sag; permanent load reduces the ratio, and flexible supports can shrink or reverse the effect.
